page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: small printed line above the title. Centre: title in large capitals in three lines, then a line of author name. Middle: woodcut engraving (tree and banner) with a line of text under it. Lower part: publisher and place lines, date line, and an italic note at the foot. No running head, no page number.
page.notes: Engraving: woodcut of a tree with a banner beneath it; the banner text under the tree is illegible. Faint mirrored text across the middle of the page is show-through from the reverse and is left out. The top line, the author line and the place and printer lines are partly rubbed; the date uses the reversed-C form, read here as M D LXXXIII; the last numerals are doubtful. "RESPVBLICÆ" and "Ioh. Sturmii." are read with doubt. The line under the engraving is illegible. The publisher line and the place line are not fully legible and may be misread.
